title: 10,000 YouTube subscribers
summary: TheySix reached 10,000 subscribers on YouTube and updated the Discord leveling system.
description: The community celebrated a major YouTube milestone while Discord members received an improved leveling system with boosted XP.

body.text: TheySix reached 10,000 subscribers on YouTube. Thank you to everyone who supported the channel.
The Discord leveling system was updated, including a temporary XP boost for members.
